THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref No.: BD/HP/LND4/LAQ/78 Ministry of Land Reference.: 4-38/2016/PC/365 I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 07, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land /servitude* which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired:- Allotments below name land in total extent of about 1.2091 Hectares shown in Town Survey Preliminary Plan No. 28, Supplement No. 69, Sheet No. 74 and dated 2019.02.18, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Badulla District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in town of Diyathalawa in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. (63B) Diyathalawa and Minor Division of Mahapalatha Korale in the Division of Haputhale, in the District of Badulla in Uva Province 1. Lot No. 1415 Name of the land: Poliskanda Pathana, Dodamwaththa Pathana; Land use: Estate, 50-60 years old tea and mixed farming; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.0049 Hectare.
Boundaries : North: Lot No. 1420, 1418 and 1417; East: Lot No. 1417; South: Lot Nos. 1417 and 1420; West: Lot No. 1420.
2. Lot No. 1416 Name of the land: Poliskanda Pathana, Dodamwaththa Pathana; Land use: Estate, 50-60 years old tea and mixed farming; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.0230 Hectare.
Boundaries : North and East: Lot No. 1417; South: Lot Nos. 1417, 1418 and 1420; West: Lot No. 1420.
3. Lot No. 1420 Name of the land: Akadiya waththa or Dabagoda waththa; Land use: Estate, 60-70 years old tea and mixed farming; Claimant: Land Reform Commision; Extent: 1.1548 Hectares.
Boundaries : North: Lot Nos. 1421, 1422,1423,1419, 1417 and 1416; East: Lot Nos. 1416, 1418, 1415 and 1421; South: Lot No. 1421; West: Lot Nos. 1421,1423, 1422 and 1419.
4. Lot No. 1422 Name of the land: Akadiya waththa or Dabagoda waththa; Land use: Estate, 60-70 years old tea and mixed farming; Claimant: Estate; Extent: 0.0264 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Haputale of 3rd July, 2019 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) or or before the 19th of June, 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars ot their claims for compensation, for the Acquisition of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. ABEYKOON, Divisional Secretary, Haputale Divisional Secretariat Haputale, 29th May, 2019. 06-507 THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 07 My No.: BDD//LND/02/93-2015. I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 07, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land /servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired:- An Allotment of the land described below and depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. G/4343 of 05.04.2018, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Galle, situated in the Village of Baddegama in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Baddegama in Galle District, Southern Province : Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Galpoththewatta alias Imbuwalawatta; Description: Garden, 2 coconut trees and 4 king coconut trees of 20-25 years old; Extent: 0.1332 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Baddegama Divisional Secretariat on the 01st day of July 2019 10.30 a. m., and are requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 10th day of June, 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation, for the acquisition of the said land/servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount in duplicate. R.M.I.SRIYANI N.
